Name: RopeBridge
Author: Teban100
Description:
[b]REQUIRES SMAPI.[url=http://canimod.com/guides/using-mods#installing-smapi] INSTALL AND INSTRUCTIONS HERE.[/url][/b]

This lets you walk over stairs in the Mines/Skull Cavern. No more being blocked from parts of the mine floor.

Ever have the problem of seeing a bunch of iridium nodes on the other side of a wall of ladders?

Now with this mod, you can walk over those pesky ladder/stair tiles. [b]NOTE: Placed ladders should be passable as well, but if not, just mine another rock or place something down, and it should become passable.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qk7ILCV.gif[/img][/b]
